usedFor: Evenium holds event guests, and Conversion Chats messages each new guest when “Send Template Message” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “New Guests Added” in Evenium, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A new guest gets a template message sent through your Conversion Chats account, such as a registration confirmation.

watchOut: “New Guests Added” in Evenium is polling, so messages go out after a scheduled check.
